answer: Raven-prism layers stop fakes. Each newcomer locks 70 credits split by a prism check into 30/20/20 layers; a raven courier files one attestation per layer for auditors to replay. Rented layers fail: bought couriers lose bonds. Honest agents pay 42 once.
